title: Rejection probability under composition
statement: Let $n>0$, let $V$ be a Boolean proof-checking system with input length $n$, proof length $\ell$, and $r$ queries, and let a seedwise reduction with $K>0$ clauses associate to each verifier seed a CNF formula of width at most three, satisfying completeness and soundness for the verifier’s local acceptance predicate. For every Boolean input word $w$ and every proof for the composed system, the rejection probability of $V$ on $w$ and the restriction of that proof to its original proof coordinates, divided by $K$, is at most the rejection probability of the composed three-query system on $w$ and the given proof.
hypotheses_covered: positive clause count $K$ and a seedwise three-CNF reduction for $V$
Boolean proof for the composed system
